rationale: Retains the Yoga node tree across layout passes instead of rebuilding it every pass, so Yoga's dirty-subtree skipping and per-node measure cache can apply at all. Touching render-assets-and-backends is core/view only: yoga_layout.cpp carries the reuse, and widget_bridge/layout_api.cpp gains static trace scopes and nothing else. Layout results are unchanged by construction and asserted so -- the same view tree yields the same geometry -- with the two reuse hazards handled explicitly: styles are written unconditionally into a pristine scratch node so a cleared property clears, and a measure signature over intrinsic size and label text re-dirties nodes whose measured content moved without their style moving. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no harness, fixture, snapshot or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
